# planetscale_vitess_branch_safe_migrations (Resource)

Manages safe migrations for an existing PlanetScale Vitess branch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "planetscale_vitess_branch" "main" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  database     = "my-database"
  name         = "main"
}

resource "planetscale_vitess_branch_safe_migrations" "main" {
  organization    = planetscale_vitess_branch.main.organization
  database        = planetscale_vitess_branch.main.database
  branch          = planetscale_vitess_branch.main.id
  safe_migrations = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) The public ID of the Vitess branch. Prefer `planetscale_vitess_branch.<name>.id` so branch renames do not replace this resource.
- `database` (String) The database the branch belongs to.
- `organization` (String) The organization the branch belongs to.
- `safe_migrations` (Boolean) Whether safe migrations (DDL protection) are enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The public ID of the branch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = planetscale_vitess_branch_safe_migrations.main
  id = jsonencode({
    organization = "my-organization"
    database     = "my-database"
    branch       = "branch-public-id"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import planetscale_vitess_branch_safe_migrations.main '{"organization": "my-organization", "database": "my-database", "branch": "branch-public-id"}'
```
